verdict.rationale: Signifyd is an e-commerce fraud-decision platform, so passing agent identity into its risk decision is an applicable axis. The evidence only covers generic Checkout/Sale order submission, device profiling, decisions and webhooks. Nothing documents agentic-payment protocol fields, signed agent tokens, or delegated spending scopes as decision inputs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pass verified agent identity — agentic-payment protocols, signed agent tokens, delegated spending scopes — into the risk decision as a first-class signal
